services.ariaLabel: Core services — web development, WordPress, SEO and design

primary.title: Web Development
primary.description: Premium, lightning-fast websites and online stores — built with Next.js 16, WordPress or fully custom code. SEO, Schema.org JSON-LD and a Firebase backend included.
primary.directAnswer: Custom web development is the design, engineering and launch of a website tailored to one business. WebDude builds every project on Next.js 16, React 19 or WordPress, with technical SEO, Schema.org structured data and Firebase baked in. Most builds are delivered in two to six weeks, fully responsive, accessible to WCAG AA and measured against Core Web Vitals targets.

primary.title: WordPress Development
primary.description: Custom WordPress themes, WooCommerce stores and plugin development. Fast, secure and maintainable — with an admin experience tailored to your team.
primary.directAnswer: WordPress is the right choice when your team wants to edit content without a developer, and standard features such as a blog or a WooCommerce store are enough. Custom Next.js development is better for complex logic, maximum speed or bespoke integrations. WebDude delivers both stacks with equal depth of experience.

primary.title: SEO Optimisation
primary.description: Technical SEO audits, content optimisation and AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) so you are found on Google and cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini.
primary.directAnswer: SEO optimisation is the technical and editorial work that makes a website rank in search engines. WebDude covers technical SEO audits, Core Web Vitals, keyword strategy, internal linking and Schema.org structured data, then refines content for Answer Engine Optimisation. Measurable organic traffic gains usually appear within three to six months, depending on how competitive your market is.

primary.title: Graphic Design
primary.description: 26 years of design experience: logos, brand identity, print collateral and UI/UX design — pixel-perfect, produced in Adobe CC and Figma.
primary.directAnswer: Graphic design is the visual language of a brand: its logo, colour palette, typography and applied assets. With 26 years of design practice, WebDude delivers logo concepts, complete brand identity, print-ready collateral and UI/UX design in Adobe CC and Figma — pixel-perfect and documented in a brand book your team can reuse.

secondary.title: AI Automation
secondary.description: OpenAI GPT-4 and Groq LLM integration, AI chatbots and CRM automation. Less manual work, more qualified leads — layered onto the business you already run.
secondary.directAnswer: AI automation suits businesses that want to remove repetitive manual processes. WebDude integrates OpenAI GPT-4 and Groq large language models into existing workflows, adds AI chat assistants and connects CRM pipelines so that inbound leads are captured, qualified and routed automatically.

directAnswers.question: What does custom web development from WebDude include?
directAnswers.answer: Custom web development is the design, engineering and launch of a site tailored to one business. Every WebDude project runs on Next.js 16, React 19 or WordPress with technical SEO, Schema.org structured data and a Firebase backend built in. Most builds ship in two to six weeks — responsive, WCAG AA accessible and tuned to Core Web Vitals targets.

directAnswers.question: When should you choose WordPress over custom Next.js development?
directAnswers.answer: WordPress suits teams that want to edit content without a developer and rely on standard features such as a blog or a WooCommerce store. Custom Next.js development wins on complex logic, maximum performance and bespoke integrations. WebDude delivers both stacks with equal depth, so the recommendation follows your roadmap rather than a preferred tool.

directAnswers.question: What is AEO and how does it differ from classic SEO?
directAnswers.answer: AEO, or Answer Engine Optimisation, structures content so AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini can quote it as a direct answer. Classic SEO targets Google rankings; AEO targets citable, self-contained answers. WebDude implements both through concise direct-answer blocks plus FAQPage, Service and Organization structured data.

directAnswers.question: What design capability does WebDude bring to a project?
directAnswers.answer: WebDude brings 26 years of graphic design practice: logo design, complete brand identity, print collateral and UI/UX design produced in Adobe CC and Figma. Because identity and code come from the same hand, nothing is lost between concept and shipped interface, and your team receives documented, reusable brand assets.

faq.ariaLabel: Frequently asked questions — web development, WordPress, SEO, design
faq.subtitle: Web development, WordPress, SEO and design — the questions clients ask most often, answered honestly and without agency jargon.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: A straightforward brochure website usually takes 2–4 weeks, while a more complex store or portal takes 4–10 weeks. The exact deadline is confirmed during the first free consultation, in writing, and I keep the deadlines I promise, with regular progress updates along the way.

items.question: WordPress or a custom-built website — which is better?
items.answer: WordPress is ideal for businesses that want to edit content themselves and rely on standard features such as a blog or a WooCommerce store. Custom Next.js development is recommended for larger systems that need maximum speed, complex logic or bespoke integrations. I have equal depth of experience in both.

items.question: What does WordPress maintenance involve?
items.answer: The standard WordPress maintenance package covers monthly plugin and core updates, daily backups, a Lighthouse audit and one hour of content update support. Pricing depends on the complexity of the project — you receive a concrete proposal during the first consultation.

items.question: How does SEO optimisation help my business?
items.answer: Technical SEO and content optimisation together increase your organic, unpaid Google traffic. I handle speed optimisation to Lighthouse 95+, keyword strategy, Schema.org JSON-LD implementation and Answer Engine Optimisation — so your business also surfaces inside AI search tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini.

items.question: When will I see measurable SEO results?
items.answer: Technical SEO changes such as speed, Core Web Vitals and structured data show measurable effects within a few weeks. Keyword ranking improvements typically appear in 3–6 months, and long-term organic traffic growth builds over 6–12 months, depending on how competitive your industry is.

items.question: What does a brand identity package include?
items.answer: A core brand identity package includes logo design with three concepts and two revision rounds, a colour palette, a typographic system and a fundamental brand guide. It can be extended with business cards, letterheads, social media templates and print collateral. Design work is produced in Adobe CC and Figma with 26 years of practice behind it.

items.question: Why work with you instead of an agency?
items.answer: You work directly with me — no project manager in between, no communication loss. I bring 26 years of graphic design and 16 years of web development experience, and I stay personally involved from first brief to launch. An agency typically charges two to three times more for the same scope, often delivered by a junior developer.

items.question: What guarantee do you offer on delivered work?
items.answer: I provide a 30-day fix guarantee after handover: any issue that appears is resolved at no additional cost. Optional monthly maintenance packages are also available, covering updates, daily backups and a monthly Lighthouse audit so your site keeps performing after launch.

items.question: What does a website or online store cost?
items.answer: Every quote is based on the real complexity of your project — after the assessment you receive a fixed, pre-agreed amount and deadline with no hidden costs. There are no off-the-shelf packages: every system is different, so the scope and the quote are designed individually. Request a free project assessment to start.
